messages.hero_description: I’m a Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer building AI-powered, web, and mobile applications using {react}, {java}, {node}, and {python}, designing production-ready REST APIs on top of {postgres}, {docker}, and well-documented APIs using {swagger}. I also work with AI agents, LLM integrations, and workflow automation with n8n.{br}{br}Currently a Full Stack Development Intern at Engineering Brasil (ENGDB), and pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems at {usp}, with a planned academic progression to Bioinformatics.
messages.about_p1: Hello! My name is Igor, and I’m a Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer with hands-on experience building AI-powered, web, and mobile applications. My interest in software development started back in 2019 when I decided to try creating games — after a few tutorials, I quickly realized that I enjoyed the problem-solving aspect of programming much more than the actual game design. Since then, I have been passionate about learning various programming languages and frameworks, from React (DOM & Native) to backend technologies like Java (Spring Boot), Node.js (NestJS), and Python (Django Ninja), and more recently AI agent development, LLM integration, and workflow automation with n8n.
